shipped_rows.title_o: Culture's consequences: International differences in work-related values
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: We argue that scores (findings) obtained by Hofstede in his previous studies conducted in Arab countries and then generalized to Jordanian culture are not scientifically valid.

parent_scope_objection: Second and final review, no budget reset. The blind citation to Hofstede 1980 with unfilled title is defensible under the printed-only extraction rule. However, that rule does not independently show that shipped Cultures consequences with a later year denotes a different original dataset/finding. The paper attributes the same Arab-country scores to multiple Hofstede editions and describes the original IBM sample. Prior Luna triage asserts equivalence but its claimed 1999 reference quotation is absent from this primary text and invalid. Thus neither presumed equivalence nor presumed distinctness is established; blind_right as a shipped-identity correction needs evidence beyond missing printed title/year. Retain that identity ambiguity for the parent. Dependent outcomes must not be transferred to a different original; do not call DOI/year differences a different original without primary identity evidence.
